title: Completed compact-support projection shift square
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D and coefficient datum C, a finite extension F of Q_(C.l), separated finite-type D.k-schemes X and Y, and a separated finite-type D.k-morphism f:X→Y. Fix a compactification c, normalized ringed models d and open comparisons b, and a uniform finite-Tor constructible integral object T on X, using [def-pur-adic-projection-trace-data], [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge] and [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. For every finite-Tor constructible K on Y, the actual ordinary-to-completed tensor unit chi at (P_c T,K) is invertible; T completed-tensor Lf* K is finite-Tor constructible; and the actual map adicProjection formed from d,b,c and this chi inverse is invertible. With these witnesses the square adicProjection_(K[1]); P_c(adicTensorInputShift_K); shift_(P_c) = completedTensor(1,adicInputShift_K); signedRightShift_(P_cT,K); adicProjection_K[1] commutes. The shifts include the full-subcategory inclusion and the normalized second-slot Koszul sign. No trace or exceptional-adjunction assertion is made.

proof.text: Choose $f=pj$. By [def-exchange-projection] the projection is the proper counit mate followed by the open tensor map and pullback composition. The proper shift square is [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]; the open square, with sign $(-1)^a$ for arbitrary first degree $a$, is [lem-pur-open-system-tensor-shift]. Thus both finite constituents have the required canonical shifts, without a concentration assumption on $T$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-strict-compactification-projection-shift] to $M=\mathcal RT$, $N=\mathcal RK$. The system projection of [lem-pur-system-level-projection-formula-coherence] is exactly its proper/open composite in the simultaneous models of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. Hence $s_H\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{M,N[1]}=\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{M,N}[1]s_F$ in the derived system category itself, for its actual quotient transitions.

source.place: Unit Step 2 (the adic stage): normalized strict-system construction, expanded proper/open projection and shift calculation

proof.text: The realization statement [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization] intertwines this composite and its whiskerings, so $\operatorname{PF}_{T,K}=c_H\mathcal L_Y(\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{M,N})c_F^{-1}$; its realized support functor is exactly the total-limit compact support of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. By [lem-pur-integral-realization-shift-coherence], $\mathcal L_Y$ and both $c$ commute with the designated-slot shifts. Apply $\mathcal L_Y$ to Step 2 and substitute these two $c$-shift equations: the adjacent $c^{-1}c$ cancel, giving the integral projection shift square, including its proper/open constituents. Invert that square using [fix-prop-projection-formula].

theorem adicCompletedProjectionShift
    (d : RingedModels C.l F) (b : RingedOpenComparisons C.l F d)
    (T : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory C.l F X) :
    ∃ (hχ : ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory C.l F Y,
        IsIso (((d.tensor Y).chi C.l F).app
          ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l F) c).obj T.obj, K.obj)))
      (hA : ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory C.l F Y,
        finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l F X
          ((integralCompletedTensor C.l F X).obj
            (T.obj, (integralDerivedPullback C.l F f).obj K.obj)))
      (hPF : ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory C.l F Y,
        IsIso (adicProjection C.l F d b c T.obj K.obj (hχ K))),
      ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory C.l F Y,
        adicProjection C.l F d b c T.obj (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧).obj (hχ (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)) ≫
            (PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l F) c).map
              (adicTensorInputShift C.l F f T.obj K).hom ≫
            ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l F) c).commShiftIso
              (1 : ℤ)).hom.app _ =
          (integralCompletedTensor C.l F Y).map
              (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) (adicInputShift C.l F Y K).hom) ≫
            ((tensorShifts C.l F).integralRight Y 1).hom.app
              ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l F) c).obj T.obj,
                K.obj) ≫
            (adicProjection C.l F d b c T.obj K.obj (hχ K))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
